summary: Niche-specific podcast host directories sourced from public RSS feeds — each podcast's RSS contains the host's public contact email, show name, episode count, and category. Paid incumbents (Rephonic, Podchaser Pro, Podseeker, FeedSpot) charge $50-300/month subscriptions for access to this data. A one-time downloadable CSV targeting a specific vertical (e.g., B2B SaaS podcasts, personal finance podcasts, health and wellness podcasts) undercuts all of them for buyers who only need one outreach campaign.

audience.who: PR agencies, startup founders doing media tours, authors launching books, B2B SaaS marketers seeking guest spots, and conference organizers looking for speaker-hosts — all need a targeted list of podcasts in their niche without paying for a monthly subscription.

data_wanted: Show name, host name, public contact email (from RSS itunes:email field), episode count, average release frequency, Apple Podcasts / Spotify category, RSS feed URL, estimated listener count (from public directory rankings where available) — all sourced from public RSS feeds and open podcast directories.

evidence.source: Podchaser Pro — charges subscription for 1.8M+ podcast contacts, proving buyers pay for this data at scale
evidence.quote: Podcast contact database with one-click contacts and bulk exporting, revealing audience size and contacts for over 1.8 million podcasts.

evidence.source: Rephonic — SaaS pitch tool for 2.5M podcasts, charging subscription vs. one-time
evidence.quote: find, qualify and pitch over 2.5 million shows

evidence.source: MillionPodcasts — confirms host contact email is in the public RSS itunes:email field
evidence.quote: Every podcast has an RSS feed that contains structured metadata including the creator's email, which the host entered when they launched, and it's publicly accessible.

evidence.source: FeedSpot — podcast media database with 2M shows and host emails, paid access
evidence.quote: Access to 2 million podcasts with direct email contacts of hosts and producers.

willingness_to_pay.signal: Podchaser Pro costs $69-299/month. FeedSpot charges for full contact access. ContactOut lists 72,493 podcast host emails as a paid product. A $29-49 one-time CSV of 300-500 niche podcasts with contact info is a no-brainer for any founder or PR manager who needs a single outreach campaign — they would pay for one month of Podchaser Pro anyway.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/podcasting, r/SaaS, r/PublicRelations, r/marketing
first_sale_path.angle: "500 B2B SaaS Podcasts — Host Emails + Stats — May 2026 CSV" — niche-specific, no subscription, formatted and ready to paste into Hunter or Lemlist. Positioned against $70/month tools: 'One campaign. One payment. Done.'
